Badminton World Championships begin in India with focus on Indian players

The BWF World Championships 2026 have commenced in India, marking the event's return to the country after 17 years. Indian players, including PV Sindhu and Ayush Shetty, are participating. Shetty notably defeated world number one Shi Yuqi. India has a medal streak at the championships since 2011. The tournament includes men's and women's singles and doubles events, with ticket and streaming information available.
